Absorb.description: A way to end a Physical or Arts debuff early. Absorb is not the same as consume.
Absorb.name: Absorb

Amp.description: Amped targets deal more DMG of the Element it is Amped for. The number represents the degree of increase. Effects of the same type can stack.
Amp.name: Amp
Amp.title: Amp

Arts Amp.description: Arts Amped targets temporarily deal more Arts DMG. The number represents the degree of increase. Effects of the same type can stack.
Arts Amp.name: Arts Amp
Arts Amp.title: Arts Amp

Arts Burst.description: Arts Bursts are triggered by stacking Arts Inflictions of the same Elements. They include Heat Burst, Electric Burst, Cryo Burst, and Nature Burst.
Arts Burst.name: Arts Burst

Arts Infliction.description:
Arts Inflictions are special Arts debuff inflicted upon the enemy. There are 4 Elements of Arts Inflctions: Heat Infliction, Electric Infliction, Cryo Infliction, and Nature Infliction.
Up to 4 stacks of Arts Inflictions of the same Element can be applied.
Arts Infliction.name: Arts Infliction

Arts Reaction.description: Arts Reactions are Arts debuffs that can be applied to the enemy. They include: Combustion, Electrification, Solidification, and Corrosion.
Arts Reaction.name: Arts Reaction
Arts Reaction.title: Arts Reaction

Arts Susceptibility.description: Arts Susceptible targets temporarily take more Arts DMG. The number represents the degree of increase. Effects of the same type can stack.
Arts Susceptibility.name: Arts Susceptibility
Arts Susceptibility.title: Arts Susceptibility

Aurora.description: A special phenomenon near the North Pole. It is actually a wall-like barrier encircling an entire zone and comprises an unending series of Æther energy ruptures. The Aurora is so-named because its brilliant colors and hues resemble an actual aurora.
Aurora.name: Aurora

Bell of Three Presences.description: An ancient Yanese bell modified using Xiranite. Such bells are usually placed near key infrastructure as they can detect the presence of Blight and automatically sound alarms to alert people nearby.
Bell of Three Presences.name: Bell of Three Presences

Blight Miasma (or simply: Miasma).description: A gaseous form of Blight that behaves like fog and mist with very ill-defined boundaries. Masses of Blight Miasma are usually found in the North Wuling Exclusion Zone.
Blight Miasma (or simply: Miasma).name: Blight Miasma (or simply: Miasma)

Blightshade.description: A replicate of a victim killed by the Æther. Such Æther copies can act independently and are extremely aggressive.
Blightshade.name: Blightshade

Breach.description: Applies Vulnerable on an enemy. If the enemy is already Vulnerable, then consume all Vulnerable stacks, deal Physical DMG, and temporarily increase the Physical DMG taken by the enemy.
Breach.name: Breach
Breach.title: Physical Status: Breach

Combustion.description:
An enemy with Combustion takes Heat DMG over time.
Combustion = A non-Heat Infliction (//) + Heat Infliction
Combustion.name: Combustion
Combustion.title: Arts Reaction: Combustion

Corrosion.description:
An enemy with Corrosion gradually loses resistance against all Elements.
Corrosion = A non-Nature Infliction (//) + Nature Infliction
Corrosion.name: Corrosion
Corrosion.title: Arts Reaction: Corrosion

Crush.description: Applies Vulnerable on an enemy. If the enemy is already Vulnerable, then consume all Vulnerable stacks and deal massive Physical DMG.
Crush.name: Crush
Crush.title: Physical Status: Crush

Cryo Amp.description: Cryo Amped targets temporarily deal more Cryo DMG. The number represents the degree of increase. Effects of the same type can stack.
Cryo Amp.name: Cryo Amp

Cryo Burst.description:
Cryo Burst = Cryo Infliction + Cryo Infliction
Applies 1 stack of Cryo Infliction and deals Cryo DMG
Cryo Burst.name: Cryo Burst
Cryo Burst.title: Arts Burst: Cryo

Cryo Infliction.description:
Cryo Infliction is a type of Arts Infliction.
Up to 4 stacks of Cryo Infliction can be applied and stacking triggers Cryo Burst.
A non-Cryo Infliction (//) + Cryo Infliction = Solidification
Cryo Infliction.name: Cryo Infliction
Cryo Infliction.title: Arts Infliction: Cryo

Cryo Susceptibility.description: Cryo Susceptible targets temporarily take more Cryo DMG. The number represents the degree of increase. Effects of the same type can stack.
Cryo Susceptibility.name: Cryo Susceptibility
Cryo Susceptibility.title: Cryo Susceptibility

DMG Over Time.description: DMG over time cannot trigger critical hits.
DMG Over Time.name: DMG Over Time

DMG Type.description:
Damage can be divided into Physical DMG, Arts DMG, and Æther DMG.
Arts DMG can be further divided into Heat DMG, Electric DMG, Cryo DMG, and Nature DMG.
DMG Type.name: DMG Type

Debuff Consumption.description: Various Physical and Arts debuffs can be ended early. For example, Crush consumes Vulnerable debuffs, while Combustion consumes Arts Infliction debuffs.
Debuff Consumption.name: Debuff Consumption

Dispel.description: This removes specific debuffs from the Operator.
Dispel.name: Dispel
Dispel.title: Dispel

Electric Amp.description: Electric Amped targets temporarily deal more Electric DMG. The number represents the degree of increase. Effects of the same type can stack.
Electric Amp.name: Electric Amp

Electric Burst.description:
Electric Burst = Electric Infliction + Electric Infliction
Applies 1 stack of Electric Infliction and deals Heat DMG
Electric Burst.name: Electric Burst
Electric Burst.title: Arts Burst: Electric

Electric Infliction.description:
Electric Infliction is a type of Arts Infliction.
Up to 4 stacks of Electric Infliction can be applied and stacking triggers Electric Burst.
A non-Electric Infliction (//) + Electric Infliction = Electrification
Electric Infliction.name: Electric Infliction
Electric Infliction.title: Arts Infliction: Electric

Electric Susceptibility.description: Electric Susceptible targets temporarily take more Electric DMG. The number represents the degree of increase. Effects of the same type can stack.
Electric Susceptibility.name: Electric Susceptibility
Electric Susceptibility.title: Electric Susceptibility

Electrification.description:
An enemy with Electrification takes more Arts DMG.
Electrification = A non-Electric Infliction (//) + Electric Infliction
Electrification.name: Electrification
Electrification.title: Arts Reaction: Electrification

Feranmut.description: Gargantuan creatures indigenous to Terra. They measure anywhere from several hundred meters to several hundred kilometers in size. Feranmuts wield supernatural powers that are completely unrelated to Originium Arts.
Feranmut.name: Feranmut

Final Strike.description: Final Strike is the last sequence of basic attack. When the controlled Operator's Final Strike hits the enemy, it also deals Stagger and restores some Skill Points (SP).
Final Strike.name: Final Strike

Fixed DMG.description: Fixed DMG ignores the target's DEF and resistances. The amount of Fixed DMG is not changed by any increase or reduction effects.
Fixed DMG.name: Fixed DMG

Fowlbeast.description: The fowlbeast (fowl) is a general term for describing any oviparous vertebrate beast covered in feathers.
Fowlbeast.name: Fowlbeast

Haste.description: Temporarily raises the movement speed of a target. The number represents the degree of the speed increase. Effects of the same type can stack until hitting the speed cap.
Haste.name: Haste
Haste.title: Haste

Heat Amp.description: Heat Amped targets temporarily deal more Heat DMG. The number represents the degree of increase. Effects of the same type can stack.
Heat Amp.name: Heat Amp

Heat Burst.description:
Heat Burst = Heat Infliction + Heat Infliction
Applies 1 stack of Heat Infliction and deals Heat DMG
Heat Burst.name: Heat Burst
Heat Burst.title: Arts Burst: Heat

Heat Infliction.description:
Heat Infliction is a type of Arts Infliction.
Up to 4 stacks of Heat Infliction can be applied and stacking triggers Heat Burst.
A non-Heat Infliction (//) + Heat Infliction = Combustion
Heat Infliction.name: Heat Infliction
Heat Infliction.title: Arts Infliction: Heat

Heat Susceptibility.description: Heat Susceptible targets temporarily take more Heat DMG. The number represents the degree of increase. Effects of the same type can stack.
Heat Susceptibility.name: Heat Susceptibility
Heat Susceptibility.title: Heat Susceptibility

Heroes of Terra.description: These refer to the heroes who, together with the Endministrator, breached the dangerous zones of the polar circle and completed a key military operation during the First Aggeloi War.
Heroes of Terra.name: Heroes of Terra

Howlerbeast.description: A beast indigenous to Talos-II that can reach great sizes. They have unique vocal cords that allow adult howlerbeasts to injure their enemies by howling. This special way of attacking gave rise to their name: howlerbeasts.
Howlerbeast.name: Howlerbeast

Hunting Arrow.description: When Typhoeus is in her Hovering state, she can consume Hunting Arrows to empower her shots, dealing higher DMG while also triggering Nature Burst.
Hunting Arrow.name: Hunting Arrow
Hunting Arrow.title: Hunting Arrow

Immobilization.description: A target affected by Immobilization cannot perform any actions for the duration of this effect.
Immobilization.name: Immobilization
Immobilization.title: Immobilization

Ink Spirit.description: An entity of ink paintings created by the Feranmut Proxy. These unique creations are made possible with Feranmut power. Some Ink Spirits are capable of autonomous actions.
Ink Spirit.name: Ink Spirit

Knock Down.description: Applies Vulnerable on an enemy. If the enemy is already Vulnerable, then add 1 stack of Vulnerable, and deal Physical DMG and Stagger.
Knock Down.name: Knock Down
Knock Down.title: Physical Status: Knock Down

La Fantoma.description: The city where the Talos-II General Chamber of Commerce is headquartered in. This coastal cosmopolis is known for its warmth, passion, points of interest, and pop music.
La Fantoma.name: La Fantoma

Lift.description: Applies Vulnerable on an enemy. If the enemy is already Vulnerable, then add 1 stack of Vulnerable, and deal Physical DMG and Stagger.
Lift.name: Lift
Lift.title: Physical Status: Lift

Link.description: Next Battle Skill or Ultimate cast by the team consumes the Link buff and deals more DMG, with Battle Skills getting a higher increase. Effects of the same type can stacks, but with diminishing returns.
Link.name: Link
Link.title: Link

Luoyi.description: An important transport hub of Hongshan Academy of Sciences (HAS). It is the earliest major city built after the establishment of HAS Headquarters.
Luoyi.name: Luoyi

Miasma Gas.description: A gaseous form of Blight that behaves like fog and mist with very ill-defined boundaries. Masses of Blight Miasma are usually found in the North Wuling Exclusion Zone.
Miasma Gas.name: Miasma Gas

Nature Amp.description: Nature Amped targets temporarily deal more Nature DMG. The number represents the degree of increase. Effects of the same type can stack.
Nature Amp.name: Nature Amp

Nature Burst.description:
Nature Burst = Nature Infliction + Nature Infliction
Applies 1 stack of Nature Infliction and deals Nature DMG
Nature Burst.name: Nature Burst
Nature Burst.title: Arts Burst: Nature

Nature Infliction.description:
Nature Infliction is a type of Arts Infliction.
Up to 4 stacks of Nature Infliction can be applied and stacking triggers Nature Burst.
A non-Nature Infliction (//) + Nature Infliction = Corrosion
Nature Infliction.name: Nature Infliction
Nature Infliction.title: Arts Infliction: Nature

Nature Susceptibility.description: Nature Susceptible targets temporarily take more Nature DMG. The number represents the degree of increase. Effects of the same type can stack.
Nature Susceptibility.name: Nature Susceptibility
Nature Susceptibility.title: Nature Susceptibility

North Wuling Exclusion Zone.description: The Exclusion Zone used to be the Wuling Science Station. After a disaster ten years ago, the entire area became ruins filled with the Blight.
North Wuling Exclusion Zone.name: North Wuling Exclusion Zone

Originium Crystal.description: The Endministrator's Combo Skill attaches Originium Crystals to enemies and immobilizes them.
Originium Crystal.name: Originium Crystal
Originium Crystal.title: Originium Crystal

Physical Status.description: Physical Statuses refer to physical debuffs applied to the enemy. They include: Lifted, Knocked Down, Crushed, and Breached.
Physical Status.name: Physical Status

Physical Susceptibility.description: Physical Susceptible targets temporarily take more Physical DMG. The number represents the degree of increase. Effects of the same type can stack.
Physical Susceptibility.name: Physical Susceptibility
Physical Susceptibility.title: Physical Susceptibility

Precursor.description: An ancient interstellar civilization destroyed by unknown causes. The legacy they left behind allowed the modern human civilization to thrive.
Precursor.name: Precursor

Protect.description: Protected targets temporarily take reduced DMG. The number represents the degree of reduction. When there are multiple effects of the same type, only the most powerful applies.
Protect.name: Protect
Protect.title: Protect

Proxy.description: The avatar that a Feranmut uses to travel in the mortal world.
Proxy.name: Proxy

Razor Clawmark.description: Rossi's battle skill applies a special status on the enemy. The affected target will take Physical DMG over time, and suffers higher Physical DMG Taken and Heat DMG Taken.
Razor Clawmark.name: Razor Clawmark
Razor Clawmark.title: Razor Clawmark

SP Return.description:
After spending SP and meeting certain criteria, some of the SP spent will be returned.
SP Return is not "SP Recovery" and does not activate SP Recovery-triggered effects. Spending returned SP does not gain Ultimate Energy.
SP Return.name: SP Return

Shatter.description: To an enemy with active Solidification, applying Vulnerable or Physical Status effects will consume the Solidification to trigger Shatter that deals massive Physical DMG
Shatter.name: Shatter
Shatter.title: Shatter

Shield.description: The Shield can absorb damage while it is active. Some Shields may only absorb specific type(s) of DMG.
Shield.name: Shield
Shield.title: Shield

Sign.description: Typhoeus gains Signs when she consumes the enemy's Nature Infliction stacks or when triggering Nature Burst on enemies. Her combo skill can then convert the Signs into Hunting Arrows.
Sign.name: Sign
Sign.title: Sign

Sky Pole.description: A small smart drone that has multiple functions, like scouting and surveillance.
Sky Pole.name: Sky Pole

Slow.description: Slowed targets temporarily suffer movement speed reduction. The number represents the degree of reduction. When there are multiple effects of the same type, only the most powerful applies.
Slow.name: Slow
Slow.title: Slow

Solidification.description:
An enemy with Solidification cannot move, and applying Vulnerable or a Physical Status to the enemy triggers the Shatter effect.
Solidification = A non-Cryo Infliction (//) + Cryo Infliction
Solidification.name: Solidification
Solidification.title: Arts Reaction: Solidification

Stagger Node.description: Some powerful enemies have Stagger Nodes. Deal enough Stagger to reach the Stagger Nodes to interrupt such enemies and make them stumble.
Stagger Node.name: Stagger Node

Status Level.description: Status Level is the number of Vulnerable or Arts Infliction stacks (max 4) consumed when triggering a Physical Status or Arts Reactions. The higher the Status Level, the stronger the resulting Physical Status or Arts Reactions.
Status Level.name: Status Level

Susceptible.description: Susceptible targets temporarily take more DMG of the element it is Susceptible to. The number represents the degree of increase. Effects of the same type can stack.
Susceptible.name: Susceptible
Susceptible.title: Susceptible

Talos.description: A gas giant with visible rings. Talos-II, the world in which we live, is its second moon. Under most circumstances, the gas giant is conspicuously visible in the sky.
Talos.name: Talos

Very Large Rift.description: The largest rift known in the Civilization Band.
Very Large Rift.name: Very Large Rift

Vulnerable.description:
Hitting an enemy for the first time with a skill with Physical Status applies Vulnerable instead of the actual Physical Status.
A Vulnerable enemy can be Lifted and Knocked Down to add more Vulnerable stacks (up to 4). Hitting a Vulnerable enemy with Crush or Breach will consume the Vulnerable stacks.
Vulnerable.name: Vulnerable
Vulnerable.title: Vulnerable

Weaken.description: Weakend targets temporarily deal reduced DMG. The number represents the degree of reduction. Effects of the same type can stack non-linearly.
Weaken.name: Weaken
Weaken.title: Weaken

Xiranite Nexus.description: An Originium device capable of instantly unleashing Xiranite energy. Its intended purpose is to seal rifts.
Xiranite Nexus.name: Xiranite Nexus

Yinglung Pass.description: A complex of containment facilities constructed to hold back the Wuling Very Large Rift. The Pass is now garrisoned by the Yinglung Special Task Force.
Yinglung Pass.name: Yinglung Pass
